title: Context fact sense-check campaign
question_template: Does this context fact make sense to you in this domain and jurisdiction? Reply with agree, disagree, unsure, and optional rationale.
disallowed_contact_sources: publicly scraped personal emails without consent or lawful basis
promotion_rule: Promote only when expert review and source checks meet the configured confidence threshold.

title: Indicator importance ranking campaign
question_template: Rank these candidate indicators in order of operational importance and flag any that are misleading or unsafe.
allowed_contact_sources: public role account with organization approval
promotion_rule: Use rankings as evidence for priority and rubric weighting, not as sole truth source.

title: Inbound email reply to knowledge-object evidence
ingest_steps: strip signatures and quoted thread text
extract answer, ranking, rationale, citations, and uncertainty
link response to review campaign and knowledge object
promotion_rule: Digest evidence can support a knowledge object, but raw email remains private unless explicitly curated.

title: Grounded search plus multi-model verification gate
promotion_rule: High-risk facts require grounded evidence and disagreement handling before deployment or public promotion.

title: Critical object escalation threshold
verification_steps: estimate harm if stale or wrong
require additional evidence channels when threshold is exceeded
promotion_rule: Critical objects cannot auto-update dependent pipelines until required evidence channels pass.
